SELECT_DISTINCT.name: SELECT DISTINCT

UNION_ALL.name: UNION ALL
UNION_ALL.reason: The graph lists it in untaught C036 with EXTRACT; this separate id requires a runnable UNION ALL refresher.

AGGREGATE_FILTER.name: Aggregate FILTER (WHERE ...)
AGGREGATE_FILTER.reason: No explicit graph lesson for aggregate FILTER; a whole-table COUNT lesson alone does not teach filtered aggregates.

ROUND.name: ROUND
ROUND.reason: No explicit graph lesson for numeric rounding; teach the function locally when displaying rounded revenue.

EXTRACT.name: EXTRACT date part

UNION.name: UNION (remove duplicates)
UNION.reason: Plain UNION removes duplicates; a UNION ALL lesson teaches keeping duplicates and cannot earn credit for this separate operation.

IS_DISTINCT_FROM.name: IS [NOT] DISTINCT FROM
IS_DISTINCT_FROM.reason: NULL-safe comparison has different truth rules from ordinary equality and NULL tests; requires its own runnable example.

CAST.name: CAST type conversion
CAST.reason: Explicit type conversion is not a column, literal or structural node; teach the conversion locally.

ARITHMETIC.name: Scalar arithmetic
ARITHMETIC.reason: Unary signs and binary arithmetic compute values; no dedicated graph lesson establishes teaching credit.
